# pcd_images_image_ids (Data Source)

Return the IDs of images in PCD's Glance service matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pcd_images_image_ids" "example" {
  name       = "Ubuntu 22.04"
  visibility = "public"
  tag        = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter by exact image name.
- `owner` (String) Filter by owning project.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `tag` (String) Filter by a required tag.
- `visibility` (String) Filter by visibility.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier.
- `ids` (List of String) The matching image IDs.
